title: Faster life-insurance enquiry handoff
challenge: New contracting enquiries sat in email and spreadsheets. Delivery and ops could not see who owned a request or whether it was waiting on the carrier or on 2Base.
solution: 2Base shipped a structured enquiry queue in CHIMS: intake fields, owner, status, and a clear waiting-on-us vs waiting-on-client split, with a documented API contract for the carrier token flow.

quote.text: We stopped asking Slack who had the last NLG pack. The queue is the source of truth.

title: Claims portal the field team actually opens
challenge: Clinicians photographed forms and emailed them. Coding errors and missing fields came back days later.
solution: A mobile-first intake with required fields, draft save, and a review queue for coding. Same design language on phone and desktop so training stayed short.

quote.text: If it works on a phone in a corridor, it ships. That was the brief.

title: KYC onboarding without the PDF pile
challenge: Compliance still collected KYC packs as email attachments. Renewal season created a two-week backlog.
solution: Checklist-driven upload, status for the merchant, and an internal review board. Drafts persist so a relationship manager can leave and return.

title: Store stock visibility for a 40-site retailer
challenge: Each store emailed a spreadsheet on Monday. Head office rebuilt a national view by Wednesday.
solution: One intake form per store, a live dashboard for ops, and a published weekly snapshot leadership can open without asking for a deck.

title: Licensing requests that no longer sit in a shared inbox
challenge: Business licence renewals arrived as PDFs and voicemails. Officers could not see who owned a request or which ones were waiting on the applicant.
solution: 2Base built a public intake form and an internal queue with owner, due date, and waiting-on-us vs waiting-on-applicant. Status is visible to the applicant so they stop calling the switchboard.

quote.text: We can tell a councillor where a licence sits without opening three inboxes.

title: Broker appointments without the spreadsheet chase
challenge: New broker appointments were tracked in a shared workbook. Compliance could not see which packs were waiting on the producer and which were waiting on Meridian.
solution: A structured appointment board in the existing portal: required documents, owner, and a clear blocked-vs-in-review split. Auth0 keeps producer and internal roles apart.

quote.text: Producers upload once. We stopped reconstructing the pack from email.
